limitations: The E18 and E19 rankings come from the 50-recording qualitative sample and one reviewer; the metric rankings from all 1,045 recordings. Their order-stability shares resample different numbers of recordings.
Kendall's tau over four models takes only seven values and is not tested; it summarises agreement between rankings, not its significance.

Concordance uses the 200 sampled captions: pairs within a recording share the recording and the references, but the pairs of one recording are not independent (the CI and test resample whole recordings). E19 ratings are one reviewer's judgements.
Metric correlations are over captions scored against five references (E12); they describe how the metrics vary together, not which metric is right.
